test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

The handloom shop at the Ring Road has many kinds of bags, such as paper, leather, cloth and cannvas.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Cannvas**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cannvas"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"Canvas"**.
 
• **"Canvas"** refers to a strong, coarse unbleached cloth used to make sails, tents, and as a surface for oil painting. (कैनवास)
 
 
• **Example:** The artist painted a beautiful landscape on the canvas.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Paper** (कागज): Material manufactured in thin sheets from the pulp of wood or other fibrous substances, used for writing, drawing, or printing on.

 
 
• **Example:** She wrote her notes on a piece of paper.
 
 
 
• **Leather** (चमड़ा): A material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.
 
 
• **Example:** He bought a new leather jacket.
 
 
 
• **Cloth** (कपड़ा): A woven or felted fabric made from wool, cotton, or a similar fiber.
 
 
• **Example:** She used a piece of cloth to clean the table.
